info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Card Case Retrieval API
info.description: The Card Case Retrieval API provides a mechanism for users to access specific card case details within the banking servicing framework. By utilizing the unique identifier provided in the request, consumers can retrieve comprehensive information related to card cases, including status, transactions, and related customer data. This API is essential for banking representatives, customer support teams, and application developers who need to troubleshoot or analyze card-related incidents. It enhances the efficiency of card case management and improves customer service experiences.

get.summary: Retrieve details for a specific card case.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch detailed information regarding a specific card case identified by its unique ID. Use this to obtain all relevant data associated with the card case, including status and updates.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the details of a specific card case identified by CARD-400045. Ensure that the request payload adheres to the defined schema for proper processing.

200.description: Request completed successfully and retrieved the card case information.
